notes.title: 1.0.3 Patch
notes.content:
[h1]A new patch is live![/h1]*

The star is a Steering Sensitivity slider added conveniently to the Pause menu which now controls both digital [i]and[/i] analog sensitivity. Just Pause, adjust to taste, and keep on keepin' on ^_^

Other changes since launch:
[list]
[*] Controls panel rearranged a bit to more clearly show Analog and Digital mappings for both Keyboard and current controller/wheel (separate steering page)
[*] Pause menu now has all in-game settings available without having to go to a separate Settings/Options page
[*] NPC headlights dimmed slightly
[*] Resolution menu now re-scans current display resolutions every time you enter it
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

[b]A big thanks goes to the community for the suggestions that resulted in these improvements![/b]

If you have any other ideas on features or quality-of-life improvements for the game, let us know here or head over to [url=https://discord.gg/2T5WmhS]our Discord[/url] to discuss!


* [i]You may need to restart Steam for the patch to download.[/i]

notes.title: BIG UPDATE: v0.8b is live!
notes.content:
Happy 4th of July, Visionaries! Nightvision v0.8b is live!

BIG UPDATE: 
- Discord integration now shows driving state, elapsed drive time, and current passphrase.
- Cloud shadows fixed.
- Fixed bug where a hole in the ground would sometimes appear along the edge of the road.
- NPC (non-player car) psychopathic tendencies reduced somewhat.
- Stopped spawning new NPCs after crash/too-slow fail.
- Fixed misaligned volume sliders (no idea how those moved... spooky!).
- Fixed ultra-rare bug where falling through the ground meant falling through time and space forever.
- Fixed misaligned stats-screen menu.
- New fail condition for Rainbow Road (secret mode).
- AI waypoint recycling (in pursuit of truly infinite Endless Mode).
- [Non-Demo Beta] Secret Visual Styles/Modes now available.
- Improved a thing I can't tell you about. :P
- Minor performance optimizations.
- Many other small bug fixes and tweaks.
